page.layout: One page of text, with two circular portrait medallions at the top centre. Running head at the top centre with the page number at the top right. Two paragraphs of running text below the medallions. No margin notes.

main_text.p: DAGOBERTVS huius nominis primus,ac Francorum Rex vndecimus succedit patri Clotario,huius nominis secundo,anno mundi 4593. à Christo nato 631. Hic viuo adhuc patre, pædagogo barbam vulsit, virgísq; eum cædi iussit:pro miraculo habetur,patris iram vitare potuisse. Fratri Ariberto Aquitaniæ regnum in partem hæreditariam dedit:Sclauos adhuc idololatras debellauit. Effeminatus Dagobertus ,scortorū & pellicum agmen secum traxit:& variis in locis formosarū collegia instituit,quæ vt Reginæ adornarentur: D.Amandus,id flagitij corripiés,in exilium mittitur.Rex Iudæos omnes qui Christum ampleāti nollent,edicto expulit. Templum D. Dionysij,ad Parisios,à fundametis erexit:ex aliis vndequaque corrasit,quò id vnū ditaret, nec quisquā ante eum patrimonij reditus annuos templis tam profusè donauit.Vascones rebelles in fidem recepit. Tandem profluuio ventris obiit anno regni 14. Pau. Emyl. lib.1.Gag.lib.3.

CLODOVEVS, huius nominis secundus, Francorum Rex duodecimus,succedit patri Dagoberto anno mun.4607. à Christo nato 645. cùm Sigibertus natu maior Austrasia contentus esset. Clodoeus & Ludouicus idem nomē est Germanicè.Sigibertus,nulla prole suscepta,Ildebertū filiū Grimoaldi adoptat:verùm mox nascitur illi filius Dagobertus:quem Grimoaldus valde puerū,& tonsum, & monachum in Scotiā mittit,patre Sigiberto defuncto:& eundem Ildebertum Austriæ Regem creat. Clodoeus hanc perfidiā minimè fert.Ildeberto in bello occisio,Grimoaldus captus, Parisiis in carcere vitā miserè finiit. Fames maxima Galliā inuadit:cui vt succurrat Clodoeus,thesauros & opes,quibus ædem D.Dionysij Dagobertus pater ornarat,aufert,obiítque anno regni 17.

page.notes: Two circular woodcut portraits with legends: left "DAGOBERTVS" and "FRAN.R.11."; right "CLODOVEVS" and "FRAN.R.12." Medallion legends are printed as picture captions, not transcribed as text. Doubtful readings: "ampleāti" (likely "ampleāti" with a macron-type abbreviation, read as printed); "Ludouicus", "Clodoeus" and "Dagobertus" spelled as printed; "Sigibertus", "Ildebertū" and "Grimoaldus" read with reasonable confidence. The "corrasit" and "Vascones" readings are clear enough but the word "Sclauos" is copied as printed.
